findings.desc: Verification coverage is not fresh at the current REVIEW head: session_brief reports materialHash drift after 5dc6684 with 7 stale verification intent entries. The active Koala role surface scans are clean, but TEST is likely to reject stale evidence unless verification_evidence_refresh_stale and validation are rerun against the current material hash.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by refreshing evidence and rerunning node bin/lattice.js validate --story=B-ffa2 --json at REVIEW head dcf1c2d/3c83020; validation passed with allPass=true and verification coverage 15/15 covered, 0 required missing.

findings.desc: Active metadata commit vocabulary still emits Koala: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:3260 and :3389 create `koala:` from-draft/INIT_CHECK metadata commits, packages/main/src/handlers/worktree.ts:318/:546/:858/:923 create or recognize `koala:` story init/discard/auto-add metadata commits, and packages/main/src/handlers/done-effects.ts:589 creates `koala:` DONE metadata commits. These are current command paths, not archive docs or signed-artifact salts, so the implementation does not yet satisfy the story requirement that active metadata vocabulary be Lattice.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved in commit c967454 by replacing active metadata commit subjects with lattice: vocabulary. Verification scan rg -n "koala:" over cli-engine.ts, worktree.ts, and done-effects.ts returned no hits; lattice: from-draft/story/discard subjects are present.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/validate-docs-drift.ts:51 still matches `koala <cmd>` even though the gate now claims to extract `lattice <cmd>`, so active Lattice command docs can be missed by docs-drift validation. The same active validation surface still emits Koala provider/schema names such as `koala-channel` at packages/main/src/handlers/validate-channel.ts:41 and user-visible summaries with `metadata-only koala CLI` at packages/main/src/handlers/validate-channel.ts:522-527, plus `koala-concept`/`koala-docs-drift`/`koala-lint`/`koala-serve-validator` provider values. These are not signed-salt or archive exceptions; they are active gates/schemas, so the migration is incomplete.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved in commits 758c57a/c967454: validate-docs-drift now extracts lattice commands, active validation providers use lattice-channel/lattice-concept/lattice-docs-drift/lattice-lint/lattice-serve-validator, and metadata summary uses lattice_metadata_changes. Verification scan for koala provider/vocab returned no hits.

findings.desc: Active docs still instruct or imply koala.config.json is a usable configuration surface after this story defines lattice.config.json as the only active project config. docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md:39 says legacy koala.config.json is ignored, but lines 41 and 101 still say validate/doctor can use or read legacy koala.config.json. docs/requirements/decisions/test-fixture-spec.md:52,377,383 still tells users to configure fixtures/browser/testRuntime via koala.config.json. This contradicts the B-ffa2 execution plan non-goal at docs/requirements/decisions/koala-to-lattice-role-naming-execution-plan.md:101 and can cause operators to rely on an ignored fallback.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved in commits 758c57a/c967454: active docs now identify lattice.config.json as canonical, legacy koala.config.json as ignored by active loader, and test-fixture-spec examples use lattice.config.json. Verification scan for koala.config.json as usable/read/configure active docs returned no hits.

findings.desc: Stale CHK-003 verification evidence remains: evidence_inspect reports stale refs CHK-003:runtime-contract, CHK-003:cli-help, and CHK-003:dispatch-compat-boundary bound to old head/material hashes even though validate is green. Remove or refresh these stale legacy evidence refs before TEST.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by replacing CHK-003 verificationEvidence through checklist_update with only the current CHK-003 happy/edge/adversarial refs, then running verification_evidence_refresh_stale and node bin/lattice.js validate --story=B-ffa2 --json. evidence_inspect now reports freshness.status=fresh with staleRefs=[].

findings.desc: Active decision docs still teach old Koala surfaces: role-separation.md instructs koala-test-analyst/koala-red-team agent roles, and cc-learnings.md still uses koala.config.json in active checklist/test instructions. These conflict with current lattice-* role naming and lattice.config.json as the only active config.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by renaming active role references in docs/requirements/decisions/role-separation.md from koala-test-analyst/koala-red-team to lattice-test-analyst/lattice-red-team, and active config instructions in docs/requirements/decisions/cc-learnings.md from koala.config.json to lattice.config.json. Verification: rg -n 'koala-test-analyst|koala-red-team|koala\.config\.json' over those files returns no matches.

findings.desc: Active test/config surfaces still depend on koala.config.json: test:gap-coverage-smoke locates only koala.config.json and fails in a lattice.config.json-only repo, and test-flow-e2e still documents/creates koala.config.json as normal sandbox config. These are active tests, not legacy docs.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by making gap-coverage-smoke locate lattice.config.json and making test-flow-e2e document/create lattice.config.json in its sandbox. npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:gap-coverage-smoke, and npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke passed; the targeted rg scan for koala.config.json in these changed files returns no matches.

findings.desc: Existing Claude agent mirrors can keep stale generated koala-* prompts after upgrade/init. packages/main/src/cli-init.ts writes the new .claude/agents lattice-* prompt files but does not remove old generated koala-* files, while the Codex path has stale prompt cleanup and managed-asset cleanup only covers .Codex/agents extras. Existing projects can therefore still expose active Claude subagents named koala-review-quality, koala-implementer, etc. after the rename.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved in implementer commit 0a180522e by adding generated legacy Koala prompt cleanup for .claude/agents during init sync and managed asset definitions. Cleanup is bounded to koala-*.md prompts recognized by managed Lattice markers or old generated name: koala-* frontmatter. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, node bin/lattice.js verify_codex, and implementer temp-dir init/managed cleanup smokes.

findings.desc: Active Lattice smoke tests still use koala.config.json as normal config outside the fixed F-007 files. lattice-evidence-smoke.ts and lattice-parallel-wave-smoke.ts write koala.config.json in normal active Lattice-named smokes that are exposed by package scripts, keeping current test surfaces teaching the legacy config name after lattice.config.json became canonical.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved in implementer commit 0a180522e by changing active Lattice-named smoke setup in packages/main/src/tasks/lattice-evidence-smoke.ts and packages/main/src/tasks/lattice-parallel-wave-smoke.ts from koala.config.json to lattice.config.json. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-evidence-smoke, npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-parallel-wave-smoke, and targeted rg over changed files returning no koala.config.json matches.
